cells.label: fact

items.text: Merrill discloses that the advisor compensation structure results in conflicts of interest, and that advisors earn compensation based on the revenue Merrill earns from the Merrill Lynch Fee, from other fees and costs not covered by that fee, from Sales Charges on brokerage account securities transactions, and from revenue derived from referrals to Affiliates.
items.quote: Your Advisor earns compensation based on the revenue that Merrill earns from the Merrill Lynch Fee paid by you in the Program and other revenue derived from certain, but not all, of the other fees and costs you incur that are not covered by the Merrill Lynch Fee. They also earn compensation based on the revenue that Merrill earns from Sales Charges related to securities transactions in any brokerage account you may have as well as from the revenue derived from the referrals to Affiliates

items.text: Merrill discloses that advisors are eligible to receive a compensation award, payable over a defined period, from an incentive program currently based on meeting growth targets from the prior year in new households and in assets and liabilities.
items.quote: Advisors are eligible to receive a compensation award, payable over a defined period of time, from an incentive program that is currently based on meeting growth targets from the prior year in new households and in assets and liabilities.

items.text: Merrill discloses that the growth in assets and liabilities component of the advisor award is based on movement of client assets into advisory programs, investment activity in specified products, opening of trust and 401(k) accounts, and client participation in banking and lending services.
items.quote: The growth in assets and liabilities component of the award is based on the movement of client assets into accounts enrolled in the Program and other of our investment advisory programs; investment activity in specified investment products...; the opening of new BANA trust accounts; the establishment of 401(k) Plan accounts; and clients' participation in banking and lending services

items.text: Merrill discloses that an advisor is subject to a reduction in their incentive compensation grid if they fail to achieve growth for two consecutive years in the assets and liabilities component of the award.
items.quote: An Advisor is subject to a reduction in their incentive compensation grid if they fail to achieve growth for two consecutive years in the assets and liabilities component of the award.

items.text: Merrill discloses that advisors do not receive additional compensation as a result of advisory client assets held in the Cash Sweep Program.
items.quote: Advisors do not receive additional compensation as a result of advisory client assets held in the Cash Sweep Program.

items.text: Merrill discloses that advisors who join from other firms generally receive recruitment payments, which may take forms including salary guarantees, upfront awards, and compensation contingent on continued employment such as deferred payments and recruitment loans, generally based on the size of the business at their prior firm.
items.quote: Advisors who join Merrill from other firms generally receive payments in connection with that move. These payments may take various forms, including salary guarantees, upfront awards and various forms of compensation contingent on continued employment (e.g., deferred payments, recruitment loans). The amount paid to Advisors under these arrangements is generally based to a large extent on the size of the business at their prior firm.

items.text: Merrill discloses that elements of field management compensation are based on revenues to Merrill and on the financial advisors they manage meeting strategic goals for the year.
items.quote: Elements of our field management compensation are based on revenues to Merrill and based on the financial advisors whom they manage meeting strategic goals set for the year, including the growth in assets and liabilities component of the award

items.text: Merrill discloses that it determines the compensation paid to its advisors on the same basis for all Program assets, without regard to the amount of compensation Merrill or its Affiliates receive, and that advisors do not receive additional compensation from a Manager Fee for a Style Manager or PAS Style Manager Strategy.
items.quote: We also determine the compensation paid to our Advisors on the same basis for all Program assets without regard to the amount of compensation we or our Affiliates receive. Our Advisors do not have an incentive to recommend certain Style Manager Strategies or PAS Style Manager Strategies over others because they do not receive additional compensation from the presence of a Manager Fee

items.text: Merrill's advisor recruiting page states advisors receive a base salary and unlimited earning potential.
items.quote: Base salary and unlimited earning potential

items.text: Merrill discloses that the amount of compensation it and its advisors receive depends on the type of account and relationship the client chooses.
items.quote: The amount of compensation we and our Advisors receive depends on the type of account and relationship you choose.

cells.reason: The passages contain multiple direct disclosures by Merrill about how advisor compensation is structured, so these are facts.
